# Vendored front-end assets

- `echarts.min.js` — [Apache ECharts](https://echarts.apache.org/) 5.6.0, Apache-2.0.
  Source: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@5.6.0/dist/echarts.min.js`
- `ECHARTS-LICENSE.txt` — upstream license text.

These files are served locally so the dashboard does not depend on a CDN at
runtime and works in offline/air-gapped deployments. Update the version and the
license together if you upgrade.
